textures.notes: Explicit paper-label alpha ROI in original photograph pixels. Case material, surrounding connector bodies and mechanical holes are excluded. Source lighting/perspective remain uncalibrated.
textures.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

tessellation.step: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; absolute deflection0.05mm, angle0.2rad, native solids plus orphan shells/faces; units converted by STEP reader to millimetres

limitations: Photograph-informed material colors are uncalibrated display approximations.
PCB UNKNOWN is an estimated blank placeholder, not a populated or manufacturing-ready board.
External connector/body inserts are photo-derived estimates where manufacturer CAD omits them.
No physical hardware measurements or flashing performed.
Exact front source contains a separate coin and slight perspective; whole-image silhouette is not a valid calibrated front profile.
Paper markings use explicit transparent source-photo masks; unlabelled shell remains a recolorable material. Photo lighting and minor paper placement are not calibrated.
Visible rear female-header housing/recess outlines are photo-derived approximations; they are separate from the shell and UNKNOWN PCB. Exact crimp/contact internals are unknown.

GPIO41 button and GPIO35 RGB output are modeled; IR, analog power/reset and unimplemented external interfaces remain unavailable. LED position is an optical proxy behind the verified CAD slot, not populated PCB CAD.
